relatedRevenue.detail: FY26 sale of material to Strides group and Steriscience Rs371.5 cr (Strides Pharma Inc Rs274.3 cr, Strides Pharma Science Rs46.8 cr, Strides Pharma International AG Rs16.3 cr, others) plus services Rs30.5 cr (Steriscience Pte Rs19.2 cr, Six Rays Rs10.7 cr)

commentary: Revenue Rs449 cr (+37% YoY, +5% QoQ) and EBITDA Rs123 cr (+39% YoY, +34% QoQ, 27.5% margin), driven by semaglutide commercial supply in Canada and India, new MSAs and new customers (CEO, 25-Jul-2026)
All three generic semaglutide approvals in Canada are with OneSource partners; two have launched. In India >40% of generic pens sold in Jun-2026 were made at its site
Dr Reddy's temporary semaglutide supply halt (API issue) did not cut volumes: capacity is full and other customers pulled demand forward
Second cartridge line commercial in Q2FY27 (doubles sterile production days from ~225); third line installed within FY27 (675 days in FY28); a fourth line later in FY28
Line 1 reached its full revenue contribution in Q1, but opex for the new lines is already in the cost base, so the margin is below steady state
Injectables: a shutdown at one sterile site in Q2-Q3FY27 to add lyophilisation and high-viscosity PFS capacity
Soft gel: capacity (0.8bn to 2.4bn capsules) to fill in 12-15 months; a greenfield site is being planned
Biologics: Formycon (biosimilars) added; RFP funnel ~4x a year ago; commercial biologics revenue from FY29
FY28 outlook reaffirmed: US$400m organic revenue, ~40% EBITDA margin, >50% ROCE (ex scheme goodwill and intangibles)
